title: Unit-trace construction and prescribed finite reductions of integral purity
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, with valuation rings and uniformizers [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. For $W=X,Y$ put $R_{E,W}=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$ and $\mathbf1_{E,W}=R_{E,W}[0]$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the derived-complete integral constructible categories and their full uniform finite-Tor subcategories $\mathscr D_E(W)=D^b_{ctf}(W,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], with normalized reduction towers [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Write $L_E=Lf_E^*$, $P_E=Rf_{!,E}$, $G_E=Rf_E^!$, $T_E=\mathbf1_{E,X}(d)[2d]$ and $H_EK=L_EK(d)[2d]$, using completed pullback and tensor, the integral compact-support functor, its specified exceptional adjunction with counit $\epsilon_E$, and Tate twists [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Use exactness and linearity in [def-weil-triangulated-category, def-weil-linear-functor]. For $E\subset F$ put $C_{F/E,W}(M)=M\otimes^L_{R_{E,W}}R_{F,W}$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], identified with strict-tower extension by $\chi$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison].
Put $E_0=\mathbf Q_\ell$, writing $0$ for this coefficient field. There exists an isomorphism $g_0:T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}G_0\mathbf1_{0,Y}$ with precisely the unit-object finite reductions of [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction]. Choose any such $g_0$ and set $t_0=\epsilon_{0,\mathbf1}\circ P_0(g_0)$. Its reduction modulo $\ell^r$ is the normalized finite smooth trace [def-pur-smooth-trace] for every $r\ge1$.
For every finite $E$ let $\theta_E:C_{E/0,X}T_0\xrightarrow{\sim}T_E$ be the canonical pullback/tensor/twist/shift comparison at the unit, and use $c_{E/0}$ of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison]. With canonical coefficient-unit constraints understood, define
$$t_E=C_{E/0,Y}(t_0)c_{E/0,T_0}^{-1}P_E(\theta_E^{-1}):P_ET_E\longrightarrow\mathbf1_{E,Y}.$$
For $K\in\mathscr D_E(Y)$ use the canonical projection map [def-exchange-projection, fix-prop-projection-formula] in the order $T_E\widehat\otimes^LL_EK$ and define
$$u_{E,K}=(t_E\widehat\otimes1_K)\operatorname{PF}_{T_E,K}^{-1}:P_E(T_E\widehat\otimes^LL_EK)\longrightarrow K.$$
Let $j_{E,K}:H_EK\xrightarrow{\sim}T_E\widehat\otimes^LL_EK$ be canonical twist reassociation followed by tensor symmetry, and define $\gamma_{E,K}=\operatorname{adj}_E(u_{E,K})j_{E,K}$, where $\operatorname{adj}_E$ is the exceptional Hom bijection.
These actual morphisms form an $\mathcal O_E$-linear natural transformation $\gamma_E:H_E\Rightarrow G_E$. At every $m\ge1$ its derived reduction modulo $\varpi_E^m$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], under the canonical operation comparisons, is exactly the prescribed finite smooth purity map of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map, thm-pur-adic-reconstruction]. Every component $\gamma_{E,K}$ is an isomorphism. No uniqueness of an arbitrary integral lift from its finite reductions is asserted. The trace $t_E$ at the cofinal levels $er$, where $\ell\mathcal O_E=\varpi_E^e\mathcal O_E$, is the scalar extension of the $\mathbf Z/\ell^r$ trace and hence the normalized trace over $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{er}$ [lem-pur-finite-universal-smooth-trace]. The same assertion at an arbitrary $m$ uses the canonical further quotient reduction.

proof.text: Obtain the completed pullback core from completedUnitPullbackTower at the base field. Obtain the counit-normalized finite right comparison and its integral target isomorphism from the target-normalization lemma. Apply purAdicReconstruction to the completed coefficient unit.

Compose sourceUnitIso inverse, the reconstructed isomorphism and the target comparison to obtain g. Transport integral constructibility along sourceUnitIso, and transport each uniform Tor bound by composing the isomorphisms of representatives. This proves finite-Tor membership of the Tate unit. Functoriality of reduction, cancellation of sourceUnitIso and the target-normalization equation turn the reconstruction reduction equation into HasPrescribedReductions for g.

For each permitted g0 apply unit_trace_counit_reductions to get the normalized reductions of its actual unitTrace. For every finite coefficient field F apply unit_trace_projection_assembly to this same trace and its reductions. This supplies exactly the conjunction and universally quantified Construction required.

(4) The quotient B->A_{E,m} via det-sp-reduction-compatibilities (3) and sk-lem-sp-reduction matches the source. (5) Naturality is elementary. (6) The reduction of j, PF and the counit gives adj_A(u_A)j_A. (7) Recomputed adj(u)σ τ = θ(1⊗P)τ; the sign is (-1)^{2d}=1. (8) Derived completeness, finite purity at m=1 and derived Nakayama give invertibility. Edge cases d=0, K=0, empty schemes, E=Q_l, m=1 and ramified e not dividing m are fine.
